hooks.command: powershell -NonInteractive -Command "$ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'; $msg = \"`n---`n## Session checkpoint — $ts`nReview this session for new pitfalls or patterns before closing.`n- [ ] New error encountered and fixed? → learnings/pitfalls.md`n- [ ] Better pattern discovered? → learnings/patterns.md`n- [ ] User made a correction? → memory/ + skill`n- [ ] New IDs / choice values created? → CLAUDE.md`n\"; Add-Content -Path '.claude/pending-learnings.md' -Value $msg"
